formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Bug Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute check on C3.1 + C3.2.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can write concurrent code and find bugs.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can write concurrent code and find bugs.
header.character_watermark: Buzz in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: Are these CONCURRENT or SEQUENTIAL? '2 robots moving forward at the same time'.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. A single C/S row with bubbles.

image_placeholders.description: A single C/S row in B&W, ~6in x 1in. Pre-printed scenario. C/S bubbles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_CS: keywords (concurrent) name the row.

prompts.prompt: Write a 2-lane code with 3 time-steps where both robots move forward.

image_placeholders.description: A 2-lane template with 3 rows in B&W, ~6in x 1.5in. Header 'Write 2-Lane Code:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_WRITE: keywords (lane, code) name the template.

prompts.answer_key: Each row should have R1=fwd and R2=fwd or similar.

prompts.prompt: Find the bug: Repeat 5: fwd. Expected outcome: 4 forwards. What's wrong?

image_placeholders.description: A find-bug slot in B&W, ~6in x 1in. 'The bug is: ___'. Header 'Find the Bug:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_BUG: keywords (bug) name the slot.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, or TRY AGAIN.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Three faces in a row labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, and TRY AGAIN.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row in B&W. Smile labelled GOT IT, neutral labelled ALMOST, frown labelled TRY AGAIN.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q4_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Score: concurrent + write + find = ready for Lesson 4.

reflection_sheet.title: My Bug Buster Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Buzz holding a Junior Bug Buster certificate. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Bug Buster? Circle one.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. Three star-rating ovals.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Bug Buster!'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 5-row YES/NO table in B&W. Rows: 'Identified concurrent events', 'Wrote 2-lane code', 'Found bugs', 'Fixed bugs', 'Made a capstone bug-busting project'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE bug-busting task?

image_placeholders.description: Five icons in B&W: concurrent, 2-lane code, find bug, fix bug, capstone. Each ~1in x 1in with selection bubble.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (icons) name the five options.

prompts.visual_layout: Lower-middle. Three tricky-moment cards in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: '2-lane reading', 'Finding bugs', 'Verifying fixes'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: '3-robot code', 'Real coding (computer)', 'Conditionals'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at end of Lesson 5 after the certificate ceremony.
